summary: This is a product page from Bokashicycle for Bokashi Culture Mix, a 400 g (1 pound) packet of wheat bran inoculated with naturally occurring microbes and fungi used to ferment food or pet waste into a soil-improving garden nutrient. The page stresses bulk buying for savings, a shelf life greater than 5 years when kept dry and protected, and that the product is shipped by FedEx with same-day order filling. It also explains that the microbes stay dormant until oxygen is lowered and eliminated in the fermenting system, a process described as natural and chemical-free. Navigation, category lists, and scripts on the page are boilerplate and were ignored.
one_line: Product page for Bokashicycle's 400 g Bokashi Culture Mix, a wheat bran microbe inoculant for fermenting food and pet waste into soil amendment.
key_facts: Bokashi Culture Mix is a 400 G (1 pound) packet sold under part number BCM12.
The listed price for Bokashi Culture Mix is $58.99 and the product is shown as In Stock.
A 12 month supply option is available for an additional $58.99.
Bokashi culture mix can be bought in bulk packs of 3, 6, 12 or 20 400 gram packets for best pricing.
Gardeners and farmers can buy 25# or 50# Bulk packs for even greater savings.
Bokashi culture mix is sometimes referred to as Bokashi Bran or Bran Mix.
Bokashicycle isolates naturally occurring microbes and fungi that rapidly metabolize organic (plant based) products.
The microbes and fungi are stabilized on wheat bran and remain dormant until activated by lowering and eliminating oxygen in fermenting systems.
The page states that no chemicals or foreign materials are used in the process.
Wheat bran culture mix shelf life is greater than 5 years when kept dry and protected.
Bokashicycle describes itself as the world's largest volume producer of bokashi wheat bran.
Bokashicycle delivers product directly to the consumer by FedEx.
All on-line orders are filled on the day the order is received.
Bokashicycle states its product provides a simple, fast and easy way of converting food or pet waste into a garden nutrient that greatly improves soil.
Bokashicycle LLC is the copyright holder of the page, dated 2024.
